description: SHA256 of canonical NPC Panel reference files, derived from the AUTHORITATIVE ZIP archive. Supersedes the previous manifest, which was hashed from the mutable extracted tree. Runtime-generated directories are excluded -- see RUNTIME_EXCLUDES in tools/reference_manifest.py.
reference_note: The extracted tree is MUTABLE -- running the reference rewrites its data/*.sqlite state files, so hash the ZIP and never the tree. The prototype's own manifests are historical evidence only: it ships five disagreeing FINAL_FILE_MANIFEST generations and 34 shipped files none of them can verify, including ui_server.py.

reference_repository.note: Authoritative for reference interpretation, and holds the complete 1,565-file inventory. See docs/migration/reference-source.md.
